evidence.what: orange dump trucks and excavator in coned-off center lanes
red traffic cones lining both sides of work zone
heavy traffic queuing in open lanes both directions

verdict.summary: Center lanes closed for roadwork with heavy equipment; expect delays and use open side lanes.
verdict.details: Central lanes of a tree-lined multi-lane road are milled and coned off for resurfacing. Three orange dump trucks and an excavator operate in the work zone kicking up dust. Heavy car, bus and truck traffic queues in the remaining open lanes both directions. Pedestrians on sidewalks, daylight, dry conditions.
